title: Ratcraft 1
description: A Vanilla+ modpack focused on exploration and performance, for Minecraft 1.21.1 on Fabric. Ratcraft 1 enhances the vanilla Minecraft experience without replacing it. Expect more to discover, smoother performance, and a world that feels good.
body:
🧀 Ratcraft 1
A Vanilla+ modpack focused on exploration and performance — for Minecraft 1.21.1 on Fabric.
Ratcraft 1 enhances the vanilla Minecraft experience without replacing it. Expect more to discover, smoother performance, and a world that feels familiar but deeper. Despite the name — no, there are no rats involved.
What does Ratcraft 1 offer?
Exploration — New structures, biomes, and reasons to venture beyond your base. The world feels more alive and rewarding to explore, whether you're spelunking through caves or crossing oceans.
Performance — Optimized to run smoothly out of the box. Includes performance mods so you can focus on playing, not tweaking settings.
Vanilla+ — Everything builds on top of vanilla Minecraft. No tech trees, no magic systems, no overwhelming new mechanics. Just more of what makes Minecraft great.
Play your way — Works great on singleplayer and servers alike. Built for casual players who want a better vanilla experience without a steep learning curve.
Who is this for?
If you love vanilla Minecraft but wish there was a little more — more places to find, more things to see, and better performance while doing it — Ratcraft 1 is for you.
